Green Card and Citizens Only 
 
 Role: ETL Informatica Developer Cloud IPaaS experience 
 Location: Indianapolis, IN 
 Duration: 6+Months 
 
 Requirements: 
 · Minimum of 7 years of experience in Data warehousing projects using Informatica ETL tool 
 · Strong experience in Informatica ETL, strong DWH concepts. 
 · Designing and developing Informatica ETL mappings, in line with current IT development standards 
 · Hands on experience in ETL code development using Informatica version 9x 
 · Should have expertise in extracting data from different source systems like flat files, XML sources, Big data appliances, RDBMS, etc., 
 · Should be proficient using Power Center 8.x and Informatica Data Quality 9.x 
 · Data integration with web services, XML, PowerCenter web services consumer transformation and Java transformation. 
 · Demonstrated strong prototyping, coding and debugging skills 
 · Cloud IPaaS experience strongly preferred 


 If you are interested in the below position please forward your profile to alih @usmsystems(dot)com or call me on 703 955-39*55
